name: noise-background
title: Noise Background
description: A static grain, film, or paper texture over a soft token gradient that drifts slowly. Pure CSS with one inline SVG noise tile.

props.name: variant
props.description: grain: fine grain. film: grain with a dark vignette at the edges. paper: soft streaky paper fibers.

props.name: color
props.description: Token used for the gradient under the texture.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of one noise tile: 120px, 200px, or 320px. Larger tiles give coarser grain.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the gradient drifts: 30s, 18s, or 10s per cycle. The texture itself never moves.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the texture.

a11y: The texture layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
The grain uses the ink token at low opacity, so ink and muted text keep their contrast.
With reduced motion, the gradient stops drifting.

ai.whenToUse: A tactile backdrop for a hero, editorial section, newsletter signup, or video promo.
rules: Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Use variant=film on dark sections and variant=paper behind long reading text
Keep intensity low behind small text

id.description: Tekstur grain, film, atau kertas statis di atas gradien token yang bergeser pelan. Murni CSS dengan satu tile noise SVG inline.

props.variant: grain: butiran halus. film: butiran dengan vignette gelap di tepi. paper: serat kertas bergaris yang lembut.
props.color: Token untuk gradien di bawah tekstur.
props.size: Ukuran satu tile noise: 120px, 200px, atau 320px. Tile lebih besar memberi butiran lebih kasar.
props.speed: Kecepatan gradien bergeser: 30s, 18s, atau 10s per siklus. Teksturnya sendiri tidak bergerak.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas tekstur.

a11y: Lapisan tekstur memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Butiran memakai token ink dengan opacity rendah, jadi teks ink dan muted tetap kontras.
Dengan reduced motion, gradien berhenti bergeser.

ai.whenToUse: Latar bertekstur untuk hero, section editorial, pendaftaran newsletter, atau promo video.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Pakai variant=film di section gelap dan variant=paper di belakang teks bacaan panjang
Jaga intensity rendah di belakang teks kecil
